nom: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing UVLOCK SPF 45

avis.texte: This sunscreen is unbearably greasy and it never soaks in. I love a dewy finish but this is too much. It also says that it's good for sensitive skin and it is definitely better than other american sunscreens ive tried, but there are better korean products for sensitive skin than this.

The formula is VASTLY different from SPF 50. Okay on its own, however I would not recommend it and will not be buying again. It's more like a regular American sunscreen than a Korean one. Save your money, search for the SPF 50+ version.

I wanted to love it, but it broke me out so bad. It feels super nice going on and gave a nice glow and protected my skin from sunburn, but I ended up with several whiteheads across my chin, cheeks and forehead after using it
I really like this and I'm on my second one. Im impressed with this line.

I am 39 and used to have acne-prone and oily skin. Right now my skin feels more on a dehydrated side, so, I like to use sunscreen that helps me with moisturizing. To skip all the steps in the morning and have only this product on my face is time-saver and force me to use enough amount of sunscreen on my face. PS. I have small face but still use 2 fingers long amount of sunscreen for its maximum benefits.
first time purchasing and will buy again!!! Doesnt pill or leave white cast/ seeps into skin nice & feels super lightweight !!
Have been using this product and the stick version while trail cycling and I like that it's minimal fragrance and goes on smoothly without being sticky and it works!

avis.titre: Not the same product as Korea
avis.texte: It itself is fine. But is absolutely not the same product with similar packaging to what is sold in Korea. I really like the one available in Korea but won't be buying this again

I had to return this, sadly. I've used a few Round Lab products before and I was excited for this sunscreen to MAYBE replace the Beauty of Joseon Relief Sun that isn't carried in the US now. Alas, this stuff is MASSIVELY greasy on my skin. I feel like my skin is even on the drier side and this just turned me into an oil slick. I'm happy for the people it works for, but if you don't like a greasy feeling on your skin I feel like this isn't the one for you. The smell is fine (I returned it, but I don't remember much of a smell if any) and the packaging is nice!
Applies well, not heavy or greasy feeling. Minimal fragrance. Very happy with product.

It's different from the authentic korean one. The english version has a stronger smell compared to the korean version. It's also way cheaper through the authentic site. I spent around 80 dollars while with the korean website, the sunscreen costs around 14 dollars and not 25

I looked for so long for a sunscreen that worked for me, then heard about this one a year ago and have been using it daily ever since! i'm acne prone and it doesn't break me out, it leaves no white cast, it's moisturizing, and goes well under makeup which i find most sunscreens don't do

I used this product as directed, and I don't have sensitive skin or use actives in my routine, but maybe it's still a "me" thing. I don't want to put down the brand! I started using it and it lowkey feels like a grease bomb on the face. I used it consistently for maybe 2 weeks and then all of the sudden a little rash popped up on my cheek.. and then my other cheek. And then after a few days the burns spread to my neck, ears, chest, and hands. It's particularly bad on my cheeks/forehead/nose bridge because that's where I put most of the sunscreen. I thought it was a different product, which is why I kept using it even a few days after it showed up, but lo-and-behold, here we are. Needless to say, I'm going back to the other brand I was using previously.

PSA for all my Korean suncare enthusiasts: This is not the Korean version of the sunscreen; it's a version that's been formulated for American consumers. I used to buy this via yes style and loved it, so I was really excited to see it for sale in the store, but as soon as I put it on at home I realized that the formula is completely different and it doesn't even smell the same, with just the basic UV protection ingredients that you'd find in any other American sunscreen. My suspicions were confirmed when I compared the list of ingredients on yes style to the ingredients list of the "same" product on the Ulta website; they aren't even the same product. While this isn't round Labs fault because the US is super annoying about innovative sunscreen ingredients, they should have made clear on the label that it is not the same formula. This is super disappointing and feels deceptive. Not happy about this.
If you are taking a short walk, or running a few errands this sunscreen works well! But for anything more intense it is not sweat proof at all
Amazing sunscreen. Great coverage, feels like a high quality moisturizer, no cast and smells great!
Very light and non sticky. Goes on smoothly and has a very light scent. Great
Love it. It's my 4th time buying and not only 1, but I buy 3-4 at a time. No white cast. Doesn't feel heavy. More natural products as opposed to the ones in the USA.

It goes on easily and doesn't have a white cast. It feels very hydrating. So far, so good. My friend gave me my first bottle that was P++++ and this one is only P+++ so it's a little disappointing to have lost a + but I'll still use it.
Was really excited about this sunscreen but its bad :( it sits on your skin and once it settles down it'll start peeling :(

avis.titre: I would buy it again just for oily skin version
avis.texte: I love how it leaves the skin but I think this is for dry skin and I'm oily skin but I like it cause it doesn't leave white cast!

my fav sunscreen but the only 1 thing I wish would change was for it to not sting my eyes. This was my first fav sunscreen ever as it is moisturizing and also no irritation to my skin at all such as my skin had no reaction to it. however only my eyes keeps getting stung by it where I felt like I was gona go blind. unfortunately I'll have to find a different sunscreen that will not burn my eyes. my skin is combination.

This Is not as good as the original Version but still good. Mildly greasy and takes more effort to spread over skin than the spf50 PA++++. Smells like other sunscreens available in the US market while the original one had virtually no odor.

I've been using this product for about two weeks so far and have really been enjoying it. It doesn't leave a white cast on my face, feels very hydrating, and leaves me with a slight glow for a while after application. It's a great final step to my skincare routine.

Do yourself a favor and just get a korean formula sunscreen. It wasn't awful, but for the first two hours of having it on, it leaves a greasy finish (if you use the amount you're supposed to) and by the time it's dried, you have to reapply and the cycle starts all over again. Though it does make your face feel very moisturized and soft once dried

avis.titre: DONT SAY I DIDNT WARN YOU!!!
avis.texte: I got this because it literally markets that it does not pill makeup, it is a physical sunscreen not a chemical one, so all it does is sit on your face in a thick greasy layer and it absolutely WILL pill your makeup, nothting will lay nicely over this!!!
Tried this for the first time and I think I will continue to use it for a long time now . Provides a shine and excellent protection

avis.titre: Best Sunblock ever, great customer service
avis.texte: This has to be the best sunblock I ever tried. It gives the skin a good glow! My first delivery got lost and the team helped me. Will buy again 100%!

I feel like this must be a different formula from the one I got from Korea. This one felt very irritating on my skin which normally isn't the case with this brand. It also doesn't feel as hydrating as before. As a chemical sunscreen, there's nothing that really stands out to me that I couldn't find in a regular unscented drugstore sunscreen. So for the pricepoint, I don't think I would recommend this to my friends. Maybe it works well for people whose skin isn't as sensitive as mine.
Disappointed. Not the same as Korea's formula. Ulta's version leaves a greasy look and feel, my skin looks SO OILY when I put it on and I normally have dry skin.
It give me irritation. Is it possible to replace it with othekind

This sunscreen moisturizer makes my skin feel like silk. I use it solely as a moisturizer, forgetting it has the added benefit of being a sunscreen. It doesn't leave a white cast, the formula is very light and much thinner than lotion sunscreen, and it doesn't have a strong smell. I'm never going to use anything else now that I've found this product!
Very light weight and didn't leave a white cast at all highly recommend!

This is one of the best sunscreens I've tried. There is no white cast, doesn't pill at all and absorbs very nicely into the skin. However this sunscreen does have a bit of an oily look, no greasy feel just an oily look, this would be amazing for dry skin or under makeup but for oily skin this may be a turn off.
It doesn't even feel like spf . It feels so smooth no white cast

This SPF is easily the most comfortable sunscreen I've tried because it feels exactly like a lightweight daily lotion. It absorbs easily and leaves the skin feeling soft and protected with absolutely zero white cast. While it's labeled as non greasy, it definitely leaves a strong glow. If you prefer a matte look or have oily skin, just be aware that the dewy finish is quite prominent throughout the day.

Many reviews talk about how this sunscreen smells like every american sunscreen, which they mean negatively. I usually like the smel of sunblock, but this to me smells like asphalt being laid. Its so chemical.
Absolutely love the feel of this moisturizer. It works so great and feels so light!
I usally buy from olive young but tried ulta and its not the same.

This is the product that convinced me to actually start using some kind of skincare on my face. I've always hated how lotions or SPFs feel, but this one actually feels nice and does t take long to dry or absorb, or whatever it's doing. I apply it after a shower in the morning and it makes my skin feel nice for the rest of the day.

texture and filters are different. ita not the worst texture but it smells like chemical sunscreen which I hate. the whole reason I chose asian sunscreens is because of the elegant fragrance formulas. wont buy again.
It's advertised as clean and reef safe. Avobenzone, Homosalate, Octisalate are all in this sunscreen, which are endocrine disruptors and are not "reef safe" ingredients.

Love this product! Has an adequate SPF 45+ protection, and goes on easily. Absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave a white haze on my skin. The hydration is great, keeping my skin hydrated throughout the day. Gives my skin a nice dewey look.
This is a very moisturized sunblock lotion. It is a bit creamy, but overall it is a great sunblock lotion.

avis.titre: Oily, formula feels different than the one I bought in Korea
avis.texte: I bought this in Korea last year and loved it. I finally ran out so bought two more online. I don't know if the formula changed, but this one makes my skin feel way more oily and slick. I will be returning

avis.titre: My favorite tried and true sunscreen!
avis.texte: This sunscreen is the best for my skin type. I have tried so many other brands of sunscreen but this one by far is my favorite and best for my skin type. And I always go back to this sunscreen. I have dry, acne-prone skin and I just find it instantly hydrates my very dry skin and no other sunscreen can compete with it. It also gives the most healthy dewy glow. Although, I didn't realize they changed the formula to US standards, so I'll try the new formula and see if it's up to my standards still.

This has been the best sunscreen I've used so far, and I've tried so many different brands & products. My skin is very sensitive so I was hesitant to try something new, but I'm really glad I did because I never have to look for another sunscreen again!

avis.titre: Love it. Does leave my sk
avis.texte: Love it. Does leave my skin oily and it absorbs quickly. Best sunscreen ever!
Used to be the best moisturizer ever, but then they changed the formula when they entered the American market and I cant do it. The smell is the same as every other sunscreen and its overwhelming.

I really have enjoyed using the Birch sunscreen. While it comes out of the tube white, it quickly melts into the skin and becomes invisible. It gives my skin such a glassy look when first applied and then mattes as it sets in. It works great under makeup. I would highly recommend!

Love love love! This is my daily go-to sunscreen. So easy to layer on at the end of my morning routine, and no white cast. I have super dry skin, and this sunscreen makes my skin feel hydrated and protected. Already recommended to my mom.

Really wanted to love this. I'm currently trying cleaner brands after years of loyalty to a different brand that I discovered was full of potential harmful ingredients. This sunscreen leaves my a little greasy/shiny looking no matter the amount I use.
This is not the high-protection Korean formula. It's a downgraded U.S. adaptation.
It feels so soft on the skin AND it leaves no whitecast! 10/10 I would definitely buy it again♡
Been using this sunscreen for the last couple months. No white cast, and it moisturizes my face!

avis.titre: Birch Moisturizing Sunscreen UVLock SPF 45+ Broad Spectrum

Two with heavy makeuo looks, one with a skin tint. Each day they pilled when i applied makeup (waited 10 min bedore applying) and it pilled around my neck in a white line.

I was hoping to love this sunscreen based on the reviews. Unfortunately it did not agree with my skin. One of the ingredients caused a reaction. I am not sure which one, but my skin is reactive and sensitive. Bottom line, it might be great for you.

Unfortunately this only has US approved UV filters. It's not terrible, but not worth the price. This one makes the skin look oily and it stings your eyes. If you have very dry skin & do not sweat, this may work perectly for you. The original (korean) version is much better.

I bought this to see what all the hype was about only to be highly disappointed. It sits far too heavy on the face, looks oily and gross instead of dewy, and pills instantly under makeup. Sad to say probably the worst sunscreen I've ever tried.
it really goes on like a moisturizer and doesn't feel thick like face sunscreen. perfect for everyday and makes me want to wear put it on.

It's not the asian formula for spf, but I find it does the trick nicely. It goes on my skin smoothly and feels lightweight as described. It's pretty good! I don't find the scent of sunscreen to be too strong in my opinion.

This is by far my favorite sunscreen i've tried, zero white cast, moisturizing, not oily, and doesn't cause me to breakout AT ALL! I have very sensitive skin and this is honestly the only product I use, besides an oil cleanser and moisturizer at night sometimes. I've always heard "sunscreen is your moisturizer" and it's true! I get so many compliments on my skin when I wear this sunscreen. It's seriously great, I don't think i'll ever switch. Oh also it's works fantastic when I wear makeup- thought I should add that. My skin looks glowy and makeup doesn't look "cakey" or splotchy. Couldn't recommend this product enough.
love how easy it goes on the skin and doesnt feel heavy. Everything from this brand does wonders for my skin since i started using it!
It feels very moisturizing on the face, kinda thick, good for dry skin.
My daily moisturizer and it protects me from the sun. Not heavy or greasy you it's perfect for thid wash and wear kind of girl like me or you can layer makeup on it for a night on the town.

I have oily skin and it does make my face look a little oily but after it dries it looks pretty matte! It also protects my skin really well and I can tell my face definitely doesn't redden as much even when i'm outside for long periods of time. I would totally recommend this product!!
The sunscreen is very lightweight and gives me a smooth texture after I applied it. It feels like putting on primer. I think it can be more lightweight, but overall I love it.

As someone with tan skin I really appreciate that this sunscreen has no white cast. It's super lightweight and way less oily than most American sunscreens I have used. I can wear it under makeup without any issues. The tube comes filled with product and this sunscreen will last me a few months.

avis.titre: Best Sunscreen I Have Ever Used
avis.texte: Hands down the single best sunscreen I have ever used. I have tried quite a few brands and I've always broken out. With this one, I not only don't break out but it's super moisturizing. Overall, I recommend this to anyone who has combination skin, needs a high quality sunscreen, and wants to feel moisturized throughout the day.
If you are of color this sunscreen does not leave a bad cast at all. The downside is that is it really greasy if your skin care has a lot of moisturizer products.

I love love this sunscreen. Its more dewy but if you like more of a matte finish, i would recommend getting the mild one. I recommend this to everyone!
I love this product. It blends nicely and does not leave a white cast on face. Will definitely repurchase.
Applies very smoothly , no significant scent or odor to the product, no white cast . All in all I like this as one of my favorite daily sunscreens!
I have been using banana boat sunscreen for years. I recently discovered this sunscreen and couldn't believe that I didn't buy it sooner! It was non-greasy and quick absorption to the skin.

I have been using this SPF for a few months and it has made my skin noticeably more plump and moisturized. As a dark skin girlie it's especially important for my sunscreen to leave no white cast and this one is fantastic! Dissolves in seconds with no oily residue. Feels like nothings on my face at all
It's so light and blends easily but I also feel confident knowing my skin is protected

I recently bought the sunscreen after reading many wonderful reviews, and it definitely lives up to the hype! It doesn't break me out and does not make my skin oily. It goes on smoothly and feels great. Highly recommend if!

Let me just start off by saying that I have combination, but mostly dry skin and I almost always have to use a moisturizer before spf, all of the sunscreens I have tried so far are irritating, they smell horrible, and they always pil with makeup. Round lab genuinely amazed me, not only is it moisturizing, it smells decent and makes my skin super hydrated and smooth. It's not too oily either, which I hate in sunscreens too. Definitely buying it again!

i suspected this was not the korean formula after opening it today and applying it. it is so much more oily than the korean version and smells different. will not be buying this product form ulta again

I absolutely LOVE the birch moisturizing sunscreen, but this is not the same as the original. The Korean version is lightweight, absorbs quickly, never feels sticky or greasy, and has no "sunscreen" smell. It is my holy grail SPF. Unfortunately, when I ordered through the U.S. website, I discovered the formula had been changed to meet regulations here. The U.S. version is completely different. Thick, greasy, and with the strong sunscreen scent I was so happy to avoid before. I wish the brand had been more transparent about the product differences. Labeling it as "Multi-award-winning. Korea's bestselling sunscreen for years" is untrue if the formula has been altered. It's disappointing to think you're getting the same product when it's not. Please be more transparent about this to your U.S. consumers.

This sunscreen does the job and its okay. But I don't like the residue feel it has. I think its better than anything you might buy in stores. But I found another one I like more so won't be buying this again. But its a great option regardless.

This is my first experience with K sunscreen. Omg now I understand the hype. I can never go back. It feels amazing on my face and I really needed something that would work well under makeup. Score!!! Recommend!

I really had high hopes but in comparison to BOJ, I could feel it resting on top of my skin and it was sticky sigh. I really wish it would have worked out. There wasn't a white cast and it made my skin look good and dewy I just couldn't tolerate the feeling of stickiness.
Love this sunscreen, it's the only one I use now. Very lightweight and leaves no white cast!
I like it because it is so easy to spread, not like some other Sunscreen and no scent!

The Birch SPF 45+ moisturizing sunscreen feels very light, absorbs easily, and has almost no scent. It even feels a bit velvety on my skin. It's the first facial sunscreen that I don't mind putting on and don't notice. 100% recommend for people who cannot stand scented and or heavy sunscreens.

The Round Lab Birch Juice Moisturizing Sunscreen SPF 45 is a hydrating, non‑greasy formula that blends effortlessly into the skin, leaving a smooth, radiant finish with reliable broad‑spectrum protection.
I love everything about this sunscreen, the lightness, how comfortable is to wear underneath makeup, that glow from within and also protectiveness
I have very sensitive skin. This sun protection doesn't smell like regular sunscreen and isn't sticky like some other sunblocks. I can use it every day and skin doesn't react in any negative way.
I've always had trouble finding a sunscreen that wouldn't break me out and also would go well under makeup. This one's perfect for that

avis.titre: It's good, but not my favorite
avis.texte: It's good. The texture is light, it blends in well with no white cast. What I'm not a huge fan of is that it feels and looks a bit oily on my skin.

avis.titre: US much worse than the Korean
avis.texte: I have used Round Lab birch juice sunscreen from Korea for many years, and this is the first time I've bought from the Round Lab US website. The formula is so different, it is sticky and greasy and stings my face and eyes. I will be returning it.

avis.titre: Birch Moisturizing Sunscreen UVLock SPF 45+ Broad Spectrum
avis.texte: i absolutely LOVE this sunscreen! it does not leave a white cast and leaves my skin feeling so hydrated.

Most sunscreens feel heavy and leave a cast of white over my face. But this one is amazing! I haven't had any issues and when I pair it with the cleanser, I've had less problems with my oily skin! It has really helped balance my skin out
This is the best sunscreen I have ever used. It doesn't leave a white cast, it's not greasy, and it doesn't make me break out. I love Korean products and I hope the ingredients always stay the same.
It came earlier than I expected. Package is intact. It's so smooth in the face. I'll definitely buy again!

avis.titre: Birch moisturizing sunscreen uv lock spf 5
avis.texte: Love this sunscreen! It feels like nothing on the skin and since I live in Hawaii with high humidity that is saying something! I love that it is reef safe with no smell. I understand the hype!

avis.titre: The product that brought me to round lab!
avis.texte: Saw this product at the top of a bunch of top sunscreen lists. It's ranked so highly for good reason - it goes on smooth, not greasy, no weird smell, doesn't sit on top of your skin - it feels like nothing. Very easy to use because it's so unobtrusive, but still effective. Love this and will evangelize to all about how great it is.

you'll see a lot of negative reviews stating that they changed the formula on this site. that's because the "UV Lock" version sold here is specifically made for the U.S. to align with our outdated FDA regulations. it's gonna perform like every terrible sunscreen you can get here. If you want the real, good korean version, i suggest getting it on olive young.

This is not the same formula as the authentic Round Lab Birch Moisturizing Sunscreen; the consistency and smell are different. I still like this version but will stick to ordering the original directly from Round Lab.
It's very light weight and gives me a nice glow. My skin became smoother as the days went on and I am so happy for that!
Please look into the ingredients before you purchase because it is not the same formulation as the authentic Korean brand. This US formulation is not acne safe!
Goes on featherweight & absorbs easily before I apply foundation. Do expect a tingling as it absorbs & keep away from your eyes.
